observation.visible_scene: A bright kitchen tabletop still life. Center: a wedge of pink raspberry meringue tart on a small white plate, already topped with a cluster of raspberries. Left foreground: a clear glass bowl holding white flour, partly out of focus. Background: a white bowl filled with raspberries. Right: a few loose raspberries resting on the table. The composition of these static elements is unchanged throughout.
visible_changes: From the top edge of the frame, individual raspberries enter and fall downward in a near-vertical stream, one after another (first visible entering around the 0.2 s mark, with multiple berries in flight later).
The falling berries descend steadily toward the tart, moving from the upper area of the frame down to just above the existing berry pile by the end of the clip.
The raspberry topping on the tart grows denser/higher as the segment progresses, consistent with the falling berries accumulating on it.
The loose berries on the table, the flour bowl, and the background berry bowl remain fixed in position, indicating a static camera with no panning or zoom.
outside_clip_unknowns: The source or hand releasing the berries (always off-screen above the frame).
The exact moment and manner of contact/bounce as each falling berry settles, which is not clearly captured within these frames.
What happens to the tart after the clip ends.
uncertain_details: Whether the perched top berry on the tart shifts or is itself part of the falling stream at the start is hard to disambiguate due to shallow depth of field.
Precise count of berries added to the pile versus already present.
Minor apparent size/position changes of background berries are likely focus/depth-of-field effects rather than motion.
